description: Get AIHOT's edited monthly report: the month's most important events chosen from its dailies, grouped by section, with an overview. Use this for what happened this month or in a given month; omit month for the latest.

lang.description: Answer language: en gives the titles, summaries and digests in English where translated (the few not yet stay in Chinese), links to the English pages and English wording; zh (the default) answers in Chinese.

month.description: Optional real month in YYYY-MM such as 2026-09. Omit for the latest monthly report.

name: aihot_get_monthly
